notes.title: About the update in the future.
notes.notes:
Now the game is not satisfactory, because it is boring. I am now adding something to make it fun. It takes about one to two months. So , it is [b][i][u]not recommended to buy now[/u][/i][/b]. If you are interested in it, you can add it to the wish list, so that you will not waste your time, nor will you have a bad impression of the game.

现在这个游戏不是令人满意的，因为它很无聊。我现在加入一些使它有趣的东西。大约需要一到两个月。[b][i][u]所以现在不建议买了[/u][/i][/b]。如果你对它感兴趣，你可以把它添加到愿望清单中，这样你就不会浪费时间，也不会对游戏产生不良印象。
